@@U00236@@
everyone shouting, great and small, happy with life. It’s here I feel, I dare to feel, human again.

@@U00238@@
To take a stroll with you, Doctor, is a real privilege, and a profit, too. But I'd never choose to lose my way alone here, sworn enemy of everything vulgar. I look around at this fiddling, screaming, bowling hubbub and think how detestable. It’s a devil-driven riot, if you ask me, and they call it pleasure, they call it song.

@@U00239@@
(PEASANTS sing and dance under the linden tree.)

@@U00241@@
The shepherd decked out in his Sunday best, Ribbons flying and flowered vest, Oh, what a sight was he! Under the linden tree they danced, Man and maid, how high they pranced. Yoo-hoo! Yoo-ho! And a hey-nonny-no! And the fiddler played, yo-hee! He pushed his way on into the swirl, Dancing on up to the prettiest girl, And jabbed her with his elbow. The sturdy lass turned round and said: “Howd you like a knock on the head?” Yoo-hoo! Yoo-ho! And a hey-nonny-no! “Show some manners, you know?” He danced in a circle and she held tight, They danced to the left, they danced to the right, And every skirt went flying.
translation:
@@U00236@@
每个人都喊着，无论大小，都对生活感到高兴。在这里我感觉，我敢于感觉，再次成为人类。

@@U00238@@
博士，能和您一起散步真是一种荣幸，也是一种收获。但我绝不会选择独自在这里迷失方向，成为一切庸俗事物的死敌。我环顾四周，看着这喧闹、尖叫、打保龄球的喧嚣，心想这是多么可憎。这是一场魔鬼驱动的骚乱，如果你问我的话，他们称之为快乐，他们称之为歌曲。

@@U00239@@
（农民们在椴树下载歌载舞。）

@@U00241@@
牧羊人穿着他周日最好的衣服，飘扬的丝带和花朵背心，哦，他真是一个景象！他们在椴树下跳舞，男人和女仆，跳得多高啊。哟吼！哟呵！还有一个嘿-老妈-不！小提琴手演奏了，哟嘿！他挤进漩涡，舞动到最漂亮的女孩面前，用肘部戳她。壮实的姑娘转过身来，道：“敲一下头怎么样？”哟吼！哟呵！还有一个嘿-老妈-不！ “表现得有礼貌，知道吗？”他绕圈跳舞，她紧紧抱住，他们向左跳舞，向右跳舞，每一条裙子都飞扬起来。
